description: Turns wall photos, flipcharts, board exports and rough notes into a capture file by block, in the room's own words, with vote counts, an unreadable log by location, questions flagged for the trainer and a list of what to clean before it travels. Use for "run fac-wall-board-capture", "here are the photos of the walls", "transcribe these flipcharts", "the workshop just ended, help me not lose this", "type up the sticky notes", "capture what the room produced", "export from my online board", "write up the dot votes", part of the Claude for Trainers and Facilitators Pack by 90n.
